originalRecommendations.name: wafsg-AzureResourceManagerLockMaliciousDeletion
originalRecommendations.title: Use an appropriate resource lock to protect the storage account's control plane.
originalRecommendations.description: A CanNotDelete lock helps prevent deletion of the storage account through Azure Resource Manager while allowing normal configuration changes. ReadOnly is more restrictive and can interfere with operations such as key listing and role assignment. Neither lock prevents data-plane deletion or modification of blobs, files, queues or tables. Combine locks with least-privilege access, service-level protection and recovery controls, and restrict who can remove a lock.

originalRecommendations.name: wafsg-LastSynchronizationTimePropertyGzrsConfigurations
originalRecommendations.title: Before initiating a failover or failback, evaluate the potential for data loss by checking the value of the last synchronization time property. This recommendation applies only to GRS and GZRS configurations.
originalRecommendations.description: This property helps you estimate how much data you might lose by initiating an account failover. All data and metadata written before the last synchronization time is available on the secondary region, but data and metadata written after the last synchronization time might be lost because it's not written to the secondary region.
